# Prevent system clock changes from extending draft recovery

## What & Why
Recovery deadlines are based on the browser clock. If the system clock moves backward while a notice is open, the visible recovery time can increase or the draft can remain available longer than intended. Protecting this edge case keeps the recovery promise tied to elapsed time rather than a clock adjustment.

## Done looks like
- Answer and opportunity recovery time never increases when the system clock changes backward.
- Draft notices still expire at the original recovery deadline after a clock adjustment.
- Browser coverage exercises the countdown and expiry behavior for both draft types.
